answer_sentences.text: The provided sources do not show a general right for a Tier 3 UCB to open a new branch in another state without RBI's prior approval; the only branch-related rule cited says a UCB may operate calamity-affected branches from temporary premises under advice to the concerned Regional Office of RBI, and for continuing the temporary premise beyond 30 days, UCBs may obtain specific approval from the respective Regional Office of RBI.
answer_sentences.quote: "88A. A UCB may operate their calamity affected branches from temporary premises under advice to the concerned Regional Office of RBI. For continuing the temporary premise beyond 30 days, UCBs may obtain specific approval from the respective Regional Office of RBI."
